label.en: Independent branches started by the origin

origin.5703.zh: 开局1天后（仅玩家）：选择封臣专长
origin.5703.en: One day after start (players only): choose the vassal specialisation

origin.5725.zh: 宗主的领袖逝世，继承危机（对其封臣）
origin.5725.en: The overlord's leader dies in a succession crisis (told to its vassals)

origin.5735.en: The empire dissolves and its vassals are released

opening.evidence: game start: hidden origin.5700 via imperial_origin_start_effect (common/scripted_effects/01_start_of_game_effects.txt:219; events/origin_events_3.txt:1545-1626) sets up the overlord; for a player vassal origin.5703 follows after 1 day (:1627-1695). The overlord side (origin_imperial_vassal_overlord) runs hidden 5715 on the five-year pulse (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:470) once 35 years have passed (events/origin_events_3.txt:2035-2085).

bridges.evidence: events/origin_events_3.txt:2057-2085 hidden 5720 kills the overlord ruler, tells every subject (5725) and schedules hidden 5730 after 360+0-1800 days; 5730 (:2105-2257) releases the subjects, converts the overlord to origin_default and fires 5735 for them.

note.zh: AI封臣在帝国解体后15–60天，隐藏5740按附近强国的专长选择其一：技术官僚、选帝侯、宫廷伯爵或联盟。
note.en: For an AI vassal 15-60 days after the dissolution hidden 5740 picks one by the neighbouring power: Technocrats (5745), Prince-Electorate (5750), Palatinate (5755) or League (5760) (events/origin_events_3.txt:2356-2520).

note.zh: 封臣获得自由、舰队与科技，可与前宗主开战或夺取领导权。
note.en: The vassals get freedom, fleets and techs; war with the old overlord or taking leadership may follow.

notes.zh: 封臣专长选择窗口：每个信息窗口（5706 / 5707 / 5708）回到5705；其余选项确定专长。
notes.en: The specialisation chooser: each information window (5706 / 5707 / 5708) returns to 5705; other options fix the specialisation (events/origin_events_3.txt:1696-1875).

uncertain: The overlord-side origin (origin_imperial_vassal_overlord) is an alias of this origin card in common/governments/civics/00_origins.txt; hidden AI setup 5710 and the opinion modifiers were not traced.
